description: Return a buyer review link for a valid UAE basket. For Research Use Only. This research-use-only catalogue is for buyers 21+ years of age and is supplied for research purposes only. Not for human or veterinary use. Optional buyer name, phone, email and address may be supplied for prefill only. The link contains those details and must be shared only with the buyer. Creates NO order. Buyer must open the link, review or correct details, accept terms and personally confirm. Card payment link follows by WhatsApp. First use search_products for exact product IDs. Supply country AE, the buyer-selected emirate and the COMPLETE items array of {id, qty}; combine duplicate IDs. Ask the buyer for any missing destination before calling. Do not send prices, totals, consent or approval flags. The example uses Dubai only for illustration: replace it with the buyer-selected emirate and replace PRODUCT_ID_FROM_SEARCH with an orderable id from search. Quote first and resolve blockers, then send the same complete basket here. No cart, session or quote ID is accepted. Buyer prefill is optional and must be nested inside buyer. Example arguments: {"country":"AE","emirate":"Dubai","items":[{"id":"PRODUCT_ID_FROM_SEARCH","qty":1}]}

buyer.description: Optional buyer-supplied prefill, accepted only by prepare_checkout. Omit if not supplied. No payment, consent or approval fields. The resulting link contains these details and is not encrypted; share only with the buyer.

address.description: Optional buyer-supplied address, up to 500 characters; do not invent missing delivery details.

email.description: Optional buyer-supplied email, up to 254 characters; use the supplied value as-is.

name.description: Optional buyer-supplied name, up to 120 characters; do not infer or invent it.

phone.description: Optional buyer-supplied phone, up to 40 characters; use the supplied value as-is.

country.description: Required delivery country code: AE means United Arab Emirates.

emirate.description: Required buyer-selected destination. Use an exact listed emirate; ask the buyer if unknown, never assume Dubai.

items.description: The COMPLETE desired basket of 1–20 distinct variant IDs. Combine the same ID into one line; send the entire updated basket on every call.

id.description: Exact id from the latest search_products result, not sku, product name or URL. Select an orderable variant.

qty.description: Quantity as a JSON integer from 1 to 10, for example 2, not "2". The field is qty, not quantity.

promoCode.description: Optional buyer-supplied promotion code, up to 24 letters or digits. Omit when absent; do not invent one.

name: prepare_checkout
